Pointers on lounge space
This article is for anyone with a companion animal

Lounge Space Guidance for Companion Animal Travelers

Aurelia Skyways keeps companion animal travel simple by making space planning part of the journey from the start. The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers understand how lounge areas are used, how animals are welcomed, and how shared spaces stay calm for everyone.

When you arrive, the desk team will look at your travel details and help you choose the best path through the terminal. They can explain where your companion animal may rest, where to wait, and how to move through the lounge with less stress. The goal is to support a smooth visit while respecting other travelers and keeping your animal comfortable.

Most lounge areas are designed for short stays and light movement. If your animal needs room to settle, the desk can guide you toward the most suitable seating or waiting area. Staff will also remind you to keep your animal close, supervised, and ready to move when needed. This helps prevent crowding and keeps the space calm.

If your journey includes a cabin team check before departure, the desk will help coordinate that step. The cabin team monitors animals during flight, and the ground process is meant to connect with that care. In this way, the service treats each journey as a shared responsibility from the terminal to the aircraft.

Travelers often find it helpful to arrive with familiar items for their animal, such as a small blanket or approved carrier. Quiet reassurance and steady handling can make the lounge experience easier. If you are traveling with more than one companion animal, let the desk know early so the team can support the best arrangement.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk is also available for changes in plans, concerns about space, or questions about what to do if your animal seems uneasy. The team will work with you in a practical, respectful way and help keep the experience orderly for everyone nearby.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways before you travel.
